evidence: Has P2P label and modifies connection management and peer eviction logic in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp to replace non-tx-relaying outbound peers.
rationale: Improves transaction relay topology and liveness by preventing outbound slots from being starved of transaction-relaying peers. As described, full-relay slots occupied by nodes that decline transaction relay (e.g., in blocksonly mode) silently degrade transaction propagation, addressing long-standing issues #16418 and #28371.
